# UnsupportedEmptyListAssignments

<Badge type="danger" text="error" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="info" text="PHP ≥ 7.0" />

Group: [Language level migration](/rules/#language-level-migration) · PhpStorm name: `UnsupportedEmptyListAssignmentsInspection`

Since PHP 7.0 destructuring into a pattern that has no target at all
(`list()`, `list(, )`, `[]`, `[, ]`) is a compile-time fatal error. In a
`foreach` value position this is easy to miss.

## Example

```php{2,5}
<?php
foreach ($queue as list(, , )) {
    tick();
}
foreach ($queue as []) {
    tick();
}
foreach ($queue as list(, $second)) {
    use_it($second);
}
foreach ($queue as [$first]) {
    use_it($first);
}
list(, $only) = $queue;
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 2: Empty destructuring pattern: PHP 7+ rejects this with a fatal error.</li>
<li>line 5: Empty destructuring pattern: PHP 7+ rejects this with a fatal error.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "UnsupportedEmptyListAssignments": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore UnsupportedEmptyListAssignments

/**
 * @noinspection UnsupportedEmptyListAssignmentsInspection
 */
```
